120969: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named Tohru. Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues.
120970: Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After Kobayashi rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid.
120971: An old friend of Tohru, he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances.
120972: Riko Saikawa is Kanna's friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead.
120973: Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. Lucoa came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him.
120974: Tohru's friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with Kobayashi as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series.
120975: Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of Tohru. She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair.
120976: Kobayashi's co-worker who is initially believed by Tohru to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year.
120977: Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which Tohru belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world.
120978: Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails.
133060: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to Kobayashi's world to destroy Tohru and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident.
172721: Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown. Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru.
209895: Sone is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.
209896: Yana is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.
209897: She is a girl that Tohru met back in her world.
236990: Taketo Aida is the grandson of Miss Aida, the owner of the candy store where Ilulu ends up getting a job. Although he starts off being suspicious of Ilulu they end up becoming friends after he's shown her kind side.
238297: A mysterious dragon hailing from the Harmony Faction.
247504: She is an American who befriends Kanna when she had quarreled with Kobayashi.
248474: Shouta's father and managing director at Kobayashi's company. He is a mage.
